explain.zh: 指示代词“任何”表示“无论什么”的意思，修饰名词时一般不带“的”，后面常有“都”或“也”与之搭配。例如：
explain.py: zhǐ shì dài cí rèn hé biǎo shì wú lùn shén me de yì si xiū shì míng cí shí yì bān bú dài de hòu miàn cháng yǒu dōu huò yě yǔ zhī dā pèi lì rú

data.explain_en: The demonstrative pronoun “任何” means “whatever; any”. When modifying nouns, it generally does not take “的”, and is often followed by “都” or “也”. For example:

text.zh: 你们以后有任何问题都可以来找我。

explain.zh: 前一分句提出假设，后一分句表示假设实现后产生的结果。例如：

data.explain_en: The first clause proposes a hypothetical condition, while the second clause indicates the resulting outcome if the condition is fulfilled. For example:

text.zh: 要是申请到奖学金，就能减轻不少经济压力。
text.py: yào shi shēn qǐng dào jiǎng xué jīn jiù néng jiǎn qīng bù shǎo jīng jì yā lì

text.zh: 随着中国的发展，越来越多的外国学生来到中国的大学学习。他们可以先上一年的中文课程，然后根据自己的兴趣和需要选择专业。除了读本科课程，他们还可以申请读硕士研究生或者博士研究生。
text.py: suí zhe zhōng guó de fā zhǎn yuè lái yuè duō de wài guó xué sheng lái dào zhōng guó de dà xué xué xí tā men kě yǐ xiān shàng yì nián de zhōng wén kè chéng rán hòu gēn jù zì jǐ de xìng qù hé xū yào xuǎn zé zhuān yè chú le dú běn kē kè chéng tā men hái kě yǐ shēn qǐng dú shuò shì yán jiū shēng huò zhě bó shì yán jiū shēng

paragraphs.en: With China's development, more and more international students are coming to study at Chinese universities. They can first take a one-year Chinese course, then choose a major based on their own interests and needs. Besides undergraduate programs, they can also apply for master's or doctoral programs.

text.zh: 在大学里，外国学生可以和中国学生一起学习、做研究、参加校园活动。通过这些交流，外国学生能更快地适应中国的大学生活。
text.py: zài dà xué li wài guó xué sheng kě yǐ hé zhōng guó xué sheng yì qǐ xué xí zuò yán jiū cān jiā xiào yuán huó dòng tōng guò zhè xiē jiāo liú wài guó xué sheng néng gèng kuài de shì yìng zhōng guó de dà xué shēng huó

paragraphs.en: At university, international students can study, do research and take part in campus activities together with Chinese students. Through these exchanges, they can adapt to Chinese university life more quickly.
